signIn.title: Sign in to austeris
signIn.wrong: That email and password do not match.
signIn.unreachable: The server cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.

form.incomplete: Some of the form is not filled in.
form.positiveAmounts: Amounts are written as positive numbers; whether money goes out or comes in is the kind of entry.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: What every account holds today, as its bank would say it.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.currencyHelp: A three-letter code: PYG, USD, RUB - or a coin's, such as BTC.
accounts.openingHelp: What was in it before austeris knew about it.
accounts.emptyBody: An account is where money sits: a wallet, a bank account, a card. Open the first one to start recording.
accounts.unconverted: Not counted - no rate known for {{currencies}}.

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: Every movement of money, newest first.
entries.emptyBody: Type a line above - 45000 food lunch - or open a full entry.

quick.label: Record an entry in one line
quick.help: Amount, category, words - then from account, @who, #tag, a currency code and @rate. A leading ~ marks it held.

entry.title: Entry
entry.counterpartyHelp: Who was paid, or who paid. A new name is created when the entry is saved.
entry.tagsHelp: One word each; press Enter after each.
entry.badTags: A tag is one word starting with a letter: {{tags}}
entry.held: Held - the bank has not posted it yet
entry.transferCurrencies: A transfer stays in one currency. Use Exchange to change money from one into another.
entry.actualAmountHelp: Only if the bank posted a different amount than was held:
entry.deleteBody: It goes to the trash with its files, and can be brought back from there as it was.

exchange.title: Exchange money
exchange.sameCurrency: Both accounts are in the same currency. That is a transfer.
exchange.noReference: no day's rate to measure against
exchange.staleNoFee: the day's rate is too old to measure against
exchange.slipRead: From the slip: {{what}}. Check it before recording.
exchange.slipNothing: Nothing legible on the slip; type the amounts. The photo is still kept with the exchange.
exchange.slipKept: The slip's photo is kept with the exchange.
exchange.slipAttachFailed: The exchange is recorded, but its photo could not be kept: {{problem}}

record.title: Record
record.description: What was just spent, in a line or with a press.
record.noButtons: No buttons yet. Open an entry below and make it a button: one press records it again.

template.name: On the button
template.askAmount: Ask for the amount each time
template.amountHelp: Left empty, the button asks each time.

entry.possible_duplicate: The same entry was recorded {{seconds}} s ago.
entry.kept: This entry is kept by {{module}}: its day, description and money change there, and it is deleted there.

line.empty: There is nothing here to record.
line.no_amount: “{{word}}” is not an amount; a line starts with one, as in 45000 food lunch.
line.zero_amount: An entry of zero records nothing.
line.no_category: What was {{amount}} for? Add a category, as in {{amount}} food, or who was paid, as in {{amount}} @shop.
line.bad_rate: “{{word}}” is not a rate; write it as @5965.
line.bare_at: @ names nothing: @5965 is a rate, @shop is who was paid.
line.twice: “{{word}}” says again what the line already said; one rate and one counterparty to a line.
line.income_category: “{{category}}” is money coming in; write +{{amount}} for that.
line.expense_category: “{{category}}” is money going out; leave the + off for money spent.
line.no_open_account: There is no open account to record this against; open one first.
line.which_account: Which account? Choose one, or write from {{example}} - you have {{accounts}}.
line.no_usual_category: “{{counterparty}}” has no usual category; say what this was for, as in {{amount}} food @{{key}}.
line.unknown_counterparty: Nobody is called “{{name}}” yet; say what this was for, as in {{amount}} food @{{name}}, and it is created with that as its usual category.
line.unknown_category: You have no category called “{{name}}”; create it first.
line.ambiguous_category: “{{name}}” is more than one category ({{names}}); say which, as in living/{{name}}.
line.rate_without_currency: A rate converts an amount in another currency; this one is already in {{currency}}.
line.no_rate: No {{from}} to {{to}} rate is known on or before {{day}}; state the one you were charged, as in @5965.

template.name_taken: There is already a button by that name.

attachment.too_large: A file can be up to {{limit_mb}} MB.
attachment.unsupported: Only a picture (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC), a PDF or an XML receipt can be kept.
attachment.already_attached: This file is on the entry already.

request.too_large: That is more than {{limit_mb}} MB - too large to send.

module.switched_off: This part of austeris is switched off on this installation.

document.unsupported: Only a receipt's XML is read into the books; a photo or a PDF is attached to its entry instead.
document.too_large: A file can be up to {{limit_mb}} MB.
document.unreadable: This file cannot be read as XML.
document.not_a_receipt: This XML file is not a SIFEN receipt.
document.several: This file holds {{count}} documents; one receipt per file.
document.not_a_payment: This is a {{kind}}, which records no payment.
document.incomplete: The receipt has no {{what}}, or it is not one.
document.unknown_account: The folder is named “{{name}}”, and you have no account called that.
document.no_rate: The account is in {{to}}, the receipt in {{from}}, and no rate is known on or before {{day}}.
document.ledger_unavailable: The books could not be reached; book it again in a moment.

slip.ocr_unavailable: This installation cannot read photos: it has no OCR.
slip.unsupported: A slip is read from a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.

trade.unknown_account: That account is not one of yours.
trade.unknown_instrument: That instrument is not in the catalogue.
trade.not_a_holding_account: Positions are held on a broker's or a wallet's account; {{name}} is not one.
trade.closed_account: {{name}} is closed; nothing new happens on it.
trade.money_not_holding: {{symbol}} is money here: it is an account's balance, not a position.
trade.fee_too_large: The fee is as much as the trade itself.
trade.nothing_moved: This trade moves less than one unit of {{currency}}.
trade.oversold: That would leave {{short}} {{symbol}} fewer than were held at the time.
trade.refused_by_ledger: The books refused the trade's money: {{message}}

portfolio.ledger_unavailable: The books are not answering; nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
portfolio.market_unavailable: Prices are not answering; nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.

files.title: Files
files.none: No files yet: a photo of the receipt, the bank's PDF.

history.title: History
history.outside: outside austeris, straight in the database

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Deleted entries and files wait here for {{days}} days, then they are erased for good.
trash.emptyStateBody: A deleted entry or file waits here for {{days}} days before it is erased.
trash.eraseEntryBody: The entry goes with its history and its files, and nothing brings it back.
trash.eraseFileBody: Nothing brings the file back afterwards.
trash.emptyBody: Everything in it is erased for good: the entries with their history and files, and the files taken off entries.

imports.title: Import
imports.description: Receipts read into the books: a SIFEN receipt's XML becomes one entry with a line per item, the shop and the file itself.
imports.paidFromHelp: For receipts that do not say - a card payment does not say which card.
imports.folder: Receipts dropped in the installation's folder arrive here too.
imports.waitingHelp: Say what each one does not, and it goes into the books.
imports.emptyBody: Choose a receipt's XML file - the one the shop e-mails - and it is in the books with its items, its shop and the file.
